fixed_inputs.state: STA-01 F2 only where authoritative interaction state requires it

study_question: Can Light F2 and exact provisional D3 preserve the same empty, loading/transitional, unavailable, failed/cancelled and provisional/non-effective meanings without theme or accent becoming lifecycle/provider/error/fiction semantics?
comparison: Keep the accepted matched empty-state app pair and render every resolved state family as a matched Light F2 + D3 witness pair.

must_preserve: empty / none selected is a valid state; empty != error or deletion
loading / transitional is application state; loading != fictional delay
capability unavailable is technical state; unavailable != Character refusal
cancelled / failed attempt creates no accepted Production mutation or narrative event
provisional / non-effective remains visibly distinct from current/effective
prior semantic origin and focus-return target remain recoverable where valid
falsification: D3 darkness itself reads as loading, error, failure, unavailability, deletion, severity or fictional consequence.
Light reads as more current, effective, healthy or complete merely because it is lighter.
Teal/accent becomes shorthand for provider availability, success, effective state, retry/recovery or progress.
Technical unavailability is visually narrativized as Character refusal, silence, incapacity or hesitation.
Loading or cancellation implies fictional time passage or causal history.
Provisional versus effective depends on theme/color rather than explicit labels and structure.
non_authority: No Scene lifecycle commands, retry/fallback policy, loading duration, progress algorithm or cancellation semantics are created.
No provider/model/cost policy, semantic status-color system, production token freeze, native implementation or Stage successor is created.
D3 remains provisional even if this local study passes.
next: Materialize the accepted state grammar in matched Light F2 + provisional D3 witnesses, run the frozen seven-condition matrix, and audit application-truth versus fiction boundaries before preservation.
